name: @arthome/core
description: The Arthome domain. Zero framework dependencies. Two entry points: the rules without zod, the boundary schemas with it.
_comment_exports: TWO ENTRY POINTS, and that is the package's structuring decision.
.        the rules. Imports zod AT NO DEPTH.
./schema the boundary schemas. The ONLY one that depends on zod.
A surface that needs only the rules pulls in not one line of zod.
zod's cost is FIXED and tied to the import, not marginal and tied to the
number of schemas (D-012): if the main entry point imported it, no
barrel-free entry point of @arthome/contracts could claw the bill back.
_comment_peer: zod is OPTIONAL: it is required only by the ./schema entry point.
A consumer that imports only the rules has nothing to install.
Exactly pinned: regime A of versions.json — two zod copies in one process
means two schema registries and unintelligible errors.
